title: Per-position setInterval(async) poll has no in-flight guard and the price quote has no timeout, so slow RPC stacks overlapping cycles on one shared state object

evidence.note: startExitMonitor: setInterval(async () => { await pollExitStrategy(...) }, 5000) with no running flag; a cycle slower than 5 s overlaps the next
queryPrice awaits the RPC with no withTimeout; only the ethers FetchRequest default bounds it
FetchRequest default timeout is 300000 ms, so one stalled quote can stack up to about 60 pending cycles per position
all overlapping cycles mutate the same state object (highWaterMark :1717-1719, volatility samples :1720, trailingActivated :1776) and each persists it (:1829)
the overrun telemetry is logged only when a cycle completes, so stacked cycles are invisible while they pile up

sibling_sites_checked: In the slice: the two exit intervals (:1906, :2007); exitWatchdog.ts and withTimeout.ts use setTimeout only, cleared in finally. Duplicate triggers from overlapping cycles are absorbed: enqueueExit dedupes per position (tryEnqueuePosition, exitManager.ts:66-71), and partial detection-to-lock is synchronous (:1732 -> :1822 -> tryAcquireSellLock :1483 with no await between), and tiers are marked before the sell lock is released (:1568-1575 before finally :1590), so no double partial was found. Same-pattern siblings outside the slice, named by path only (owned by their slices): src/bot.ts (:1636, :1660, :1740, :1774), src/anti-rug/detector.ts (:1261), src/api/server.ts (:186).
severity_rationale: S2, equal to the research suggestion. Overlap is proven by the code. Its money effect is bounded because the queue and sell locks absorb duplicate triggers; what remains is unbounded pile-up of pending cycles and sockets during an RPC stall, stale-ordered state writes, and no exit decisions until the stall clears (a stalled quote also skips the urgency exit, AUD-EXIT-003).
recommendation: Run each position poll as a self-rescheduling setTimeout (or skip a tick while one is in flight) and bound queryPrice with withTimeout. Card EXIT-04 (exit-path liveness). Phase 29 unless Phase 24 folds it into the exit fixes.
